title: Fourier spectral concentration
statement: For a function $f\colon\{-1,1\}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}$, a real number $\varepsilon$, and a set $\mathcal{F}$ of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, say that the Fourier spectrum of $f$ is concentrated on $\mathcal{F}$ with error at most $\varepsilon$ when the Fourier weight of $f$ outside $\mathcal{F}$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the Boolean cube on $n$ coordinates to the real numbers
A set of subsets of the coordinate set
